name: billing-period-input
title: Billing Period Input
description: Reads a recurring price back per period (₹499/month = ₹5,988/year) and, against a reference price, catches a yearly price in the monthly field, a team total entered per seat and other implausible jumps, each with a one-tap fix.

meta.stops: Yearly price typed into monthly plan
meta.summary: Reads a recurring price back in every billing period and catches a yearly price typed into the monthly field.
catches: A yearly price entered as monthly, or the reverse
A team total entered as a per-seat price
Large jumps from the reference price (current plan, plan below or last year's)
Misreading the rate, by showing it in every period
limits: The mix-up checks need a reference price; without one it only reads back
Weeks are converted as 12/52 of a month, so readbacks are approximate for weekly plans
a11y: Visible <label> tied to the input, described by an aria-live="polite" status
Price basis is a role="radiogroup" of role="radio" buttons
The period selector has an aria-label
Warnings use an icon plus text
